subject.title: Install ClawHub packages for new Claw agents

question: Should an exact `claws add --yes --plan-integrity` consent be accepted as sufficient authority for a Claw definition to install or reuse a process-wide plugin on the shared OpenClaw host?
rationale: This is an intentional trust and ownership boundary, not a mechanical correctness question: plugins are process-wide, while the proposed feature creates per-Claw lifecycle actions.

options.title: Approve shared-host consent model
options.body: Accept the experimental exact-plan grant for shared plugins after the contributor supplies exact-head live proof for install, reuse, and compensation.

options.title: Limit this slice to workspace skills
options.body: Keep the managed workspace-skill lifecycle and defer process-wide plugin mutation until a host-level grant model is defined.

options.title: Pause the package-owner slice
options.body: Hold both paths until the RFC or owners define the permanent package authority boundary.

recommendation.title: Limit this slice to workspace skills
recommendation.body: Keep the managed workspace-skill lifecycle and defer process-wide plugin mutation until a host-level grant model is defined.

likelyOwner.reason: Their detailed lifecycle review establishes the most concrete current ownership signal for the package contract.
